Adds node2 in dc2, ALTERs keyspace to replicate to dc2 (rack lists), waits for this table's 'Streaming for tablet migration of <table_id>:N finished' on node2, waits for compactions and asserts every sstable on node2 spans <=1.5 windows.

Guards TWCS segregation of repair-received data (repair skips segregation and relies on off-strategy, scylladb/scylla#9199).
